description: Upload media for use in generation. Returns presigned URLs for clients that can upload bytes themselves; run the returned `curl_template` or POST the `upload.fields` form to `upload.url`, then call confirm_upload. Default path for user-attached image/video/audio whose bytes your code environment can read (e.g. /mnt/user-data/uploads in Claude): call this, run the `curl_template` with curl, then confirm_upload — do not ask the user to re-upload. Fall back to upload_media_widget only when the file is unreadable or the POST fails.

bytes.description: The file's real size in bytes, read off disk: signed as the upload's hard limit.

content_type.description: MIME type for single file upload, e.g. 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', or 'video/mp4'.

name: upload_media
title: Upload a file from this machine
